notes.zh-CN: 优化 Bot 设置中的 CLI 选择区：选项采用等宽网格，随窗口宽度和文字大小自动换行，MiMo、Qwen Code 等末尾选项不再被截断。保留直接切换和选中态，补充键盘焦点与辅助技术状态。macOS 为 universal 包，未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: The CLI picker in Bot settings now uses an equal-width grid that wraps with the window and text size, keeping all choices including MiMo and Qwen Code visible. Direct switching and the selected state are preserved, with visible keyboard focus and accessible selection state. macOS is universal and not notarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The APK is debug-signed. The IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
